international.title: Trump hosts third crypto gala for meme coin amid conflict of interest outcry
international.summary: Virginia dinner comes as Democrats accuse president of improperly profiting from his cryptocurrency ventures Donald Trump has headlined his third cryptocurrency gala at his ​country club in Virginia, rewarding top holders of his own meme coin, as Democrats accuse the president of improperly profiting from his crypto ventures. The dinner, which took place at the Trump National golf club in Sterling, Virginia, included meet-and-greets with Trump supporters including the boxing champion Floyd Mayweather, the Shark Tank investor Kevin O’Leary, the NBA champion Tristan Thompson and the magician Lior Suchard, according to the event’s website .
